title: green-mintz
description: Mint, commission, buy, sell, and trade art as NFTs. Liquid crypto is the funding book. Cash App is only an edge hop. User steers pools in Grok. User watches and can stop.

future.confirmThreshold: not specified yet — replace all-or-nothing with criteria

livePolicy.existingBtcNote: Cash App BTC under $10 stays on the ramp. Prefer Lightning to Coinbase. Do not on-chain hop this size.
livePolicy.stopMeans: user says stop. Cancel open Coinbase orders. Revoke the trade key.

userDoes: Cancel open Coinbase orders. Revoke view+trade key if needed.
killSwitch.afterStop: Nothing keeps buying. Optional return hop to Cash App later.

decentExit.purpose: Good-enough timing helper for a user-signed sell. Not a Cash App trading engine. Not Auto Invest.
decentExit.goodEnoughRule: Open a 10-minute window on public BTC-USD. Bias to sell in the first print at or above the window open, or after a small bounce off an early dip. Market at minute 10 if nothing nicer.

execution.rampOnly: Cash App sell only if the user is flattening on the ramp to dollars, not as the strategy

custody.holder: user Cash App (ramp) and user Coinbase / wallets (books)

purpose.bestPart: mint own art, take commissions, list and trade NFTs for real work — commissioning, buying, selling
purpose.fundingBook: Coinbase Advanced Trade *-USDC so the art book has liquid capital
purpose.onRamp: Cash App moves value in and out. Lightning first, USDC second, on-chain last.
purpose.notThePoint: trading inside Cash App or holding BTC for its own sake

commissions.role: human commission work sits next to minting. Not NFT fills.
flow: share finished or in-progress art into green-mintz
choose keep-private, offer-as-commission, mint-as-nft, or any mix
open VGen or Fantia with a tap list — user posts and delivers there
do not mint a client's exclusive piece without an explicit rights flag
doesNot: treat VGen or Fantia as NFT markets

onlineOnly.preferLowFee: Advanced Trade maker/taker, not Cash App market buy/sell and not Coinbase Simple
onlineOnly.identity: Coinbase US still asks for ID. That is not a bank.
onlineOnly.smallSeedHop: Lightning Cash App BTC balance → Coinbase Lightning invoice. Not on-chain.

rails.inPreferred: Cash App Lightning pay-from-BTC to a Coinbase Lightning invoice the user creates. Grok never supplies an invoice.
rails.inFallback: Sell on Cash App to dollars, send USDC on Solana/Base to the user's Coinbase USDC address.
rails.inLocked: On-chain BTC until the pile clears Cash App free Standard floor (~100,000 sats).
rails.trade: Coinbase Advanced Trade any liquid *-USDC spot pair. View+trade key only. Transfer off.
rails.out: Return hop to the user's Cash App receive (Lightning if both sides allow, else on-chain when size allows). Dollars via native Cash App Sell + Cash Out.
rails.stop: Say stop here. Cancel open Coinbase orders. Revoke the trade key.

kernelSu.onlyIf: user device already has KernelSU; GrokBot never installs a root manager
kernelSu.purpose: local mining and local mint prep only
allowed: extra CPU/GPU/IO inside GrokBot's own process
cgroup / cpuset / nice for mine and mint workers
wake-lock with thermal and battery caps
local IPFS or metadata encode for own-art mint
forbidden: su into Cash App, Coinbase, wallets, or any other package
hide KernelSU from banking or exchange apps
read another app's private data by privilege

safety.mustShow: ROOT OPTIONAL badge when the worker is armed
safety.noRootPath: mint still works via user wallet sign

kernelSu.honesty: A phone will not profit-mine Bitcoin.

liquidCryptoMeans: other Coinbase *-USDC with a real book
pools.userTurns: any pool or venue weight to 0 instantly

shareTarget.primaryLanding: art mint-and-list when the payload is an image the user made
alsoAccepts: Cash App screenshot as hop insight only
doesNot: store a receive address in Grok chat

ux.emptySeedCopy: Ramp pile is too small for on-chain. Use Lightning or leave it. Sliders are armed.

flow: user shares an image into GrokBot or picks a file
coach picks cheapest viable chain (Base or Solana first)
list on NFT venues whose weight is above zero
doesNot: spend the Cash App seed on 0.25 ETH companion mints

layoutLikeJapanglify.domain: pure Kotlin/JVM — pools, hop policy, decent-exit, share classify, stop. Zero Android deps.
layoutLikeJapanglify.app: Android shell — share target, Retrieve, Art, sliders. Depends on domain. No domain→app dep.
layoutLikeJapanglify.appTests: manual on the user's spare unrooted phone

domainMustCover: venue weight renormalize and zero-weight means no new capital
hop policy: lightning first, usdc second, on-chain locked under Standard floor

device.kernelSu: off — this device tests the no-root path only
mustStillWork: wallet sign if a wallet is installed

testing.userPhone: Lightning hop of the tiny seed after Confirm screen shows cents

invariants: Cash App is an edge hop, never the trading engine
No Auto Invest or Custom Orders as product requirements
Development: user confirms every coach step
Production: coach auto-accepts pool math; venue and wallet Confirm stay with the user
Never emit a Grok or project Bitcoin address or Lightning invoice
Never ask for Cash App PIN, biometrics, or login
Refuse any request to send Bitcoin to Grok
